0.0.n: A standard daytime greeting suitable for this public introduction.

0.2.n: 年度 refers to an organizational or fiscal year rather than necessarily a calendar year.

0.3.n: Marks this year as another year of his captaincy.

0.4.n: A borrowed word naming his team leadership role.

0.5.n: Marks the role held with 務める; English naturally expresses this with as.

0.6.n: 務める becomes 務めさせていただく, a humble expression presenting his service as something others allow him to do.

0.7.n: His family name, placed before his given name in Japanese.

0.8.n: His given name, following the family name 石川.

0.9.n: Politely completes his self-introduction; the subject I is understood.

1.0.n: 今 combines with the borrowed word シーズン to specify the current sporting season.

1.1.n: Links this season to its biggest goal.

1.2.n: Describes the goal as the greatest in importance.

1.3.n: Connects 最大 to 目標, forming a phrase that English renders as biggest goal.

1.4.n: Names the objective, with the Olympic qualifiers standing for the team's main competitive target.

1.5.n: Marks the biggest goal this season as the topic being discussed.

1.6.n: Combines directly with 予選 to identify which competition the qualifiers are for.

1.7.n: Refers to the qualifying competition for entry into the Olympics.

1.8.n: Marks the outcome with なる, identifying what the main goal will be.

1.9.n: Literally means become, but here presents what the season's main goal will be.

1.10.n: Introduces a reason for the commitment stated in the following clause.

1.12.n: そこ refers back to the qualifiers, and で marks the event where they will secure qualification.

1.13.n: Literally a right to participate, referring here to Olympic qualification.

1.14.n: Marks 出場権 as what the team will obtain.

1.15.n: Expresses strong certainty and determination when combined with に.

1.16.n: Makes 絶対 describe how firmly the speaker commits to obtaining qualification.

1.17.n: 獲得する becomes the polite 獲得します; here it expresses a firm future commitment.

0.lit: Hello. This year too, I am Ishikawa Yuki, who has the honor of serving as captain.
0.tip: 務めさせていただく humbly presents his captaincy as a role he has been allowed to perform.

1.lit: This season's biggest goal will be the Olympic qualifiers, so there we will definitely obtain the right to participate.
1.tip: ので connects the season's main goal to the team's firm promise to secure Olympic qualification.
